column1: # The edits of the Mac target's edits.map whose new instructions are longer than their range: the x86-64 Linux
# build writes a jump at the range to the new instructions (linux/src/patch.c), which covers the range and,
# where that is under 5 bytes, the instructions after it, moved. `no` when something in the function goes to
# an address inside the covered bytes or they pass the function's end: a breakpoint then, covering the range
# alone. fixes: the new and the moved instructions that hold a distance the build corrects.
# Made and checked by linux/check_patch_sites.py from the pinned image.
# address, range, new, covered, fixes, yes|no, why.
